info.title: ClinicFlow API
info.description: Ukrainian clinic CRM. UTC appointments, integer minor-unit money. Opaque 15-minute bearer tokens held in memory; rotating 14-day HttpOnly cookie. No global platform-admin patient access.

post.description: Allowed roles: Public; refresh/logout use HttpOnly same-site cookie. All clinic paths require active membership in an active clinic. Cross-tenant resources return 404. All errors have a request_id.
